'''Pipe Converger''' is an [[AIC]] [[Facilities|facility]] in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''.

{{Item description|A logistics unit that merges up to 3 pipelines into 1 single pipeline.|A pipeline adjustment unit with a smart sorting module. Can be used in all sorts of production lines.}}
==Usage==
A logistics unit that merges up to 3 pipelines into 1 single pipeline.

The Pipe Converger can converge up to 3 pipelines into a single pipeline.
==Acquisition==
*Requirement : [[AIC Plan#Wuling AIC Plan|Wuling AIC Plan - Wuling AIC I - Pipe Fittings]]
